plan.title: Repeat order requires old PO reference

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed RFQ.
Allocate the available line item to the vendor named by the case.
Verify the available line item and vendor are selected for the proposal.
Open the proposal form after allocation.
Answer Yes to the repeat-order question.
Leave the required old PO reference field empty.
Verify submission is refused while the old PO reference number is blank.
